tax.text: He pledged no new taxes and said he would rein in government spending.
tax.quote: Brandon has taken the “No New Taxes” pledge and will fight to rein in wasteful government spending that fuels inflation.

debt.text: He said he would oppose cuts to Social Security and Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: Brandon will oppose cuts to Social Security and Medicare benefits that seniors rely on.

schools.text: He said he would support national school choice and legislation directing education dollars to follow students.
schools.quote: Brandon will sponsor legislation ensuring education dollars follow the student, whether they attend public, private, or parochial school

guns.text: He opposes new firearm regulations and supports repealing the National Firearms Act.
guns.quote: Oppose any new regulations on firearms and sponsor the repeal of the NFA.

abortion.text: He opposes government funding for abortion and supports the Infant Born Alive Act.
abortion.quote: Brandon is committed to defending life at every stage. He will oppose all government funding for abortion and, on day one, sponsor the Infant Born Alive Act

tax.text: She opposes tax cuts for billionaires and calls for a fair tax code alongside support for SNAP and public investment.
tax.quote: I don’t believe we should be giving billionaires tax cuts at a time when we are debating whether vulnerable children should have food provided by SNAP benefits.

wages.text: She says she would support raising the minimum wage and requiring paid parental leave.
wages.quote: support families by raising the minimum wage and requiring paid parental leave

trade.text: She said Trump tariffs raise costs and drive inflation, while calling for Congress to regulate unilateral presidential tariffs.
trade.quote: The Trump Tariffs are raising costs for everyone and driving inflation.

schools.text: She says she will fight for strong public schools.
schools.quote: Strong public schools that empower the next generation. A future where opportunity is not determined by your ZIP code.

immigration.text: She supports humane vetting and reasonable pathways to citizenship while also calling for border security.
immigration.quote: provide fair and humane vetting and reasonable pathways to citizenship for our neighbors who are living and working here.

guns.text: She supports universal background checks, red flag laws, and safe firearm storage measures.
guns.quote: including universal background checks, red flag laws, safe firearm storage, and stronger protections for survivors of domestic violence.

abortion.text: She says reproductive rights should be protected and abortion-related medical decisions should remain between a woman and her doctor.
abortion.quote: A woman should have rights over her own body and choices.

health.text: She supports expanding Medicare to cover all Americans and strengthening the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: Expand Medicare to all Americans, strengthen the Affordable Care Act

energy.text: She supports rejoining the Paris Climate Accord and grounding climate policy in science.
energy.quote: Fight climate change by rejoining the Paris Climate Accord and centering policies on established climate science

voting.text: She supports expanding voter registration and ballot access, including same-day registration and mail-in ballots.
voting.quote: promote online voter registration, same-day registration, public school voter registration, expansion of voting accessibility, and expansion of mail-in ballots.

tax.text: In a 2023 city-council interview, he said high property taxes were causing people to abandon properties and needed to be addressed.
tax.quote: People are walking away from their properties because they can’t afford to pay their taxes

safety.text: He identified a lack of law and order as a major concern and called for enforcing trespassing laws.
safety.quote: There's a lot of vagrants and a lot of people are trespassing onto properties because there are a lot of vacant properties

immigration.text: He called for prohibiting open borders and Temporary Protected Status while also supporting expanded H-2A and H-2B visas.
immigration.quote: Prohibit OPEN BORDERS. 2. Prohibit Temporary Protective Status (TPS) 3. Prohibit Anchor Babies. 4. Prohibit religious fanatical Immigration. 5. Support and expand Seasonal H-2A & H-2B Visas

health.text: He proposed putting uninsured people into Medicare and eliminating middleman insurance companies.
health.quote: The MENDOZA PLAN would put all uninsured into Medicare SR and18 year olds into Medicare JR. No More Middleman Insurance Companies.

energy.text: He called for oil and gas subsidies and listed protecting oil and gas interests among his priorities.
energy.quote: Congress needs enact oil & gas subsides for refineries, farmers, business and WE THE PEOPLE!
